scope: Only fixed source and five previously retained images

cases.explicit_keys: Left/Right or A/D selects stage, Enter/KeypadEnter starts selected available stage, Tab help, Esc quit.
cases.click_receivers: Stage icon and name ClothButton select; bottom ClothButtons quit/help/start. Selecting island alone does not call StartSelectedStage.
cases.looks_non_button: Selection text and stage subtitles are labels. Island/name are actual receivers, not decorative-only claims.
cases.selection: SelectedStageIndex controls yarn loop + いま選んでいる場所; stage-name cloth also becomes bright when selected OR hovered. Brightness is not keyboard focus. Start is passed selected=chosen.available for rendering.
cases.close: Esc or quit cloth invokes QuitFromTitle; help opens separately.
cases.limits: Unavailable stage remains selectable, start is disabled by chosen.available and StartSelectedStage rejects it. Actual disabled contrast, hit areas after GUI.matrix scaling, OS focus and click behavior untested.

cases.explicit_keys: Esc resumes; T opens return confirmation; Tab opens help. In confirmation Esc cancels back to pause, Enter/KeypadEnter returns to selection.
cases.click_receivers: WoodButton resume/title and confirmation cancel/accept. Volume +/- buttons, HorizontalSlider, preview/reset buttons and scroll view use IMGUI controls.
cases.looks_non_button: Volume labels and help-entry sentence are labels, not separate click targets.
cases.selection: No custom menu-selected variable or keyboard-focus renderer found in this path. WoodButton tints by pointer containment; implicit IMGUI focus remains unverified.
cases.close: Resume click corresponds to Esc. Cancel does not resume gameplay. Help closed from pause returns to pause.
cases.limits: No explicit volume hotkeys in this receiver; IMGUI default keyboard editing was not tested. Sound callback is not audible evidence. Overlay mouse/game input concern stays in existing08.

cases.explicit_keys: Tab or Esc closes; the destination depends on whether help was opened from title, play or pause.
cases.click_receivers: Bottom GUILayout.Button Tab / Esc 閉じる calls CloseHelp. Help key/description rows are GUILayout.Label.
cases.looks_non_button: Close control uses helpKeyStyle derived from GUI.skin.label, the same style passed to key labels. Text-like appearance does not mean it is non-clickable.
cases.selection: No custom focus/hover distinction confirmed for close text in the scoped renderer. Label-style inheritance is not proof that IMGUI focus is absent.
cases.close: Key and bottom-button paths call CloseHelp; paused state survives. Existing08 covers close-frame guards, not rerun here.
cases.limits: Old screenshot is a Sep30 static draw fixture. Actual clickable bounds, focus and mouse overlap have not been tested.

cases.explicit_keys: After fall presentation ends: R checkpoint retry, Esc selection. Tutorial/Main R+Esc precedence differs as documented in08.
cases.click_receivers: No button/click receiver in HimoHitoFailureScreen.Draw. R wood is DrawWoodButtonLabel; Esc is GUILayout.Label.
cases.looks_non_button: R wood plate resembles real WoodButton controls used on pause/clear, but the draw helper supplies no GUI.Button.
cases.selection: The failure wood helper adds no hover/action/focus event receiver. This says nothing about OS focus.
cases.close: Esc is selection, not resume/dismiss failure. R retries from snapshot; no alternative click behavior claimed.
cases.limits: A conditional code finding, not a reproduced click failure. New UI or click implementation is outside scope.

cases.explicit_keys: Enter/KeypadEnter goes to Main; Esc selection; R restarts Tutorial through a separate Update branch.
cases.click_receivers: Primary WoodButton goes to Main; secondary WoodButton returns to selection. No displayed R-restart button in the clear view.
cases.looks_non_button: Both displayed wood commands are actual GUI.Button wrappers. The restart R shortcut is not represented by these two visible button choices.
cases.selection: WoodButton custom rendering reads pointer hover, not keyboard focus. The displayed primary has no custom keyboard-selected variable.
cases.close: Esc/selection click are the same destination. R restart differs from Enter/primary click; do not label all R checkpoint retry.
cases.limits: Hidden R is a source/display coverage difference, not automatically a blocker needing new UI. Clear UI appearance is not a focus trace.

cases.explicit_keys: R restarts Main; Esc selection. No explicit Enter/KeypadEnter handling in MainStageGoalZone.Update.
cases.click_receivers: Primary WoodButton restarts Main; secondary returns to selection.
cases.looks_non_button: Main old image uses same family of wood command plates as failure, but here they have GUI.Button receivers.
cases.selection: Same hover-only custom rendering caveat. No conclusion about built-in IMGUI Enter activation or tab order.
cases.close: R/primary and Esc/secondary pair to their own same destinations.
cases.limits: Do not claim Enter is impossible: this audit covers explicit Update handling and does not execute IMGUI default focus activation.

focus_search.boundary: Zero references in these ten source files is not proof that Unity IMGUI has no focus or keyboard behavior.
